_metadata.description: Inline risk score formula weights for Wazuh Normalization Layer
_metadata.reference: Based on Splunk CIM risk_score + Microsoft Sentinel risk scoring methodology
notes: All values are configurable here — no Python code change needed.
Adjust multipliers based on your SOC environment and false-positive rate.

formula.description: inline_risk_score = min(cap, floor(rule_level * level_multiplier) + asset_score + bonus_sum)

asset_criticality_scores.comment: Added to base score based on host_criticality field in CEM

ocsf_severity_bias.comment: Added from ocsf_mapping.json severity_bias per category — applied after asset score

bonuses.comment: Each boolean field in CEM adds a fixed bonus if true

category_multiplier_overrides.comment: Override level_multiplier for specific categories. Leave empty to use global value.
